plan.topics:
Introduction: What is Natural Language Processing? Origins of NLP, Language 
and Knowledge, The Challenges of NLP, Language and Grammar, Processing Indian 
Languages, NLP Applications.  
Word Level Analysis: Morphological Parsing, Spelling Error Detection and Correction, 
Words and Word Classes, Part-of Speech Tagging.  
Syntactic Analysis: Context-Free Grammar, Constituency, Top-down and Bottom-up 
Parsing, CYK Parsing. 
Transformers: Motivation behind transformers, self-attention mechanism, architecture, 
BERT basics and pretrained models.
plan.extra_instructions: Refer to the scheme and syllabus document and generate for - Inteeligent language processing

metadata.title: Intelligent Language Processing Mid-Semester Internal Assessment
metadata.instructions: Answer all questions to the best of your ability. Ensure you clearly label each question with its corresponding number. Use additional sheets if necessary.

questions.question_text: Explain the fundamental concepts of Natural Language Processing (NLP), including language models and grammar structures. How do these concepts relate to transformer-based architectures?
questions.answer_key: The answer should cover the basics of NLP, language models, grammar structures, and how these are utilized or enhanced by transformer-based architectures. Reference to Textbook 1: Ch 1, Ch 2, Ch 3, Ch 4 and the importance of understanding these concepts as per CO1.
